test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 9.
solution:
The correct answer is 'concept.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us see the meanings of the given words:
 
 
• Concept: an abstract idea. (एक अमूर्त विचार।)
 
• **Perception**: the ability to see, hear, or become aware of something through the senses. (इंद्रियों के माध्यम से किसी चीज को देखने, सुनने या जानने की क्षमता।)
 
• **Impression**: an idea, feeling, or opinion about something or someone, especially one formed without conscious thought or on the basis of little evidence. (किसी चीज या किसी व्यक्ति के बारे में एक विचार, भावना या राय, विशेष रूप से बिना सचेत विचार के या थोड़े साक्ष्य के आधार पर बनाई गई।)
 
• **Assumption**: a thing that is accepted as true or as certain to happen, without proof. (ऐसी बात जिसे बिना प्रमाण के सत्य या निश्चित होने के रूप में स्वीकार किया जाता है।)
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is 'concept.'
 
• The correct phrase: *..... t**oday is the originator of the service-dog **concept**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 

 
• The meaning of the word 'originator' isa person who creates or initiates something.

 
 
• Example: *Wegener was the** originator** of the theory of continental drift.*
